signals.title: Benda’s Rock 707 could be the smartest cruiser you’ve never heard of
signals.summary: Benda’s new Rock 707 is a 692cc V-twin cruiser with electronic clutch technology and automatic air suspension. Benda is adding a new cruiser to its burgeoning range as the 692cc, V-twin-powered Rock 707 joins the family. You may also like to read our Benda LFC 700 review . And while the classic bobber styling is the first thing to catch the eye, it’s the spec sheet for this bike that is arguably the big talking point. The engine which powers the bike is a fairly unassuming liquid-cooled V-twin, boasting a beginner-friendly 72bhp and 68Nm (50lb ft) of torque. What connects the engine with the back wheel, though, is where things get interesting. Benda has fitted the bike with its BEC (Benda Electronic Clutch) MK-III system, which does a similar job to Yamaha’s Y-AMT and Honda’s E-Clutch. The technology allows the rider to pull away, change gear and come to a halt without touching the bike’s clutch lever. As is the case with the Honda system, full manual control is still possible, as the Rock 707 retains a traditional clutch lever on the bars. The chassis of the bike features a steel tube frame and aluminium swingarm, with non-adjustable USD forks that are mated to a single four-piston disc brake set-up. Where things get really interesting, though, is at the back of the bike. Instead of conventional twin shocks, which are pretty much de rigueur on a bike like this, the Benda wears a pair of dual-chamber electronic air suspension units. The system allows for automatic ride height

signals.title: Tickets for one Indian Motorcycle’s biggest 2027 events are already on sale
signals.summary: Indian Motorcycle has confirmed the Indian Riders Fest will return in June 2027 following this year’s record attendance. Following a record attendance at this year’s event, Indian Motorcycle has already revealed details about the 2027 Indian Riders Fest, including dates and location. The four-day event takes place from 17-20 June, in Lipno nad Vltavou, which is located in the South Bohemia region of the Czech Republic. It will feature live entertainment every evening and plenty of riding opportunities, while custom bikes will also be on display as part of the AMD-Approved Budweis Custom Show. This is the only international custom bike show exclusively dedicated to the American motorcycle maker. Full details for the 2027 event have not yet been confirmed, however, Indian Motorcycle says visitors can expect the festival to include a drag strip on an airfield. The public can also expect to see various stunt shows and the company’s latest models, with demo rides available. Christophe Thevenet, Director of International Sales for Indian Motorcycle, said this about next year’s event: “The growth of the IRF has been impressive, and it has become a highlight of the event calendar outside of North America. signals.title: Suzuki’s latest special edition is apparently inspire by a speedboat engine
signals.summary: The Suzuki GSX-R1000R Stealth edition draws inspiration from the Suzuki Stealth Line outboard engine range. Suzuki fans in Italy can now get their hands on a new special edition, as the GSX-R1000R Stealth Edition is launched. You may like to read our Suzuki GSX-R1000R review . The bike is said to be inspired by Suzuki’s Stealth Line outboard engine range, meaning it gets a black paint job with gloss and matte accents, which are said to give it an “aggressive yet elegant look”. Other changes for the new model are light, with the titanium Akrapovic exhaust being the only notable technical update. Other changes are rear seat cover, carbon fibre winglets, a smoked screen and a limited edition number decal on the airbox cover. The new bike will be priced €21,690 (around £18,500) although simply being an Italy resident doesn’t guarantee bagging one as just ten are set to be produced. The new model, which is sadly only available in Italy, has us reminiscing about the GSX-R1000R Phantom model. The Phantom, which was revived most recently in 2021 featured a number of technical and aestheitc updates, including a Yohimuira exhaust system, a smoked double bubble screen, single seat cowl, tank pad, fuel cap trim, and track-focused brake and clutch lever guards. The first Phantom edition of the GSX-R appeared in the mid-2000s, on the now-legendary K6. signals.title: Sam Sunderland completes the first leg of his world record attempt on a new 2027 Triumph Tiger 1200
signals.summary: Sam Sunderland has reached Istanbul after covering 2,356 miles in the opening leg of his attempt to break the motorcycle circumnavigation record. Sam Sunderland has completed the first leg of his attempt to become the fastest person to circumnavigate the world on a motorcycle, covering 2,356 miles from Greenwich to Istanbul in 39 hours and 34 minutes. You may also like to read our Triumph Tiger 1200 review . The two-time Dakar Rally winner and Red Bull athlete set off from Greenwich at 03:00 UTC on Saturday 5 September, beginning an attempt to beat the existing motorcycle circumnavigation record of 19 days, 8 hours and 25 minutes. Sunderland reached Istanbul at 21:50 UTC on Sunday 6 September, having ridden through England, France, Italy, Slovenia, Croatia, Serbia, Bulgaria and Turkey. The first leg forms part of an 18,000-plus-mile route which will take him across five continents and through two antipodal points. The clock is stopped for overseas crossings, meaning Sunderland's time aboard the Le Shuttle between England and France does not count towards his record time. Rest periods, however, are included, making the 39-hour, 34-minute running time for the opening leg a significant first marker in the attempt. The first leg was not completely straightforward, either. Sunderland accidentally travelled around 20 miles off route during the opening section, with the clock continuing to run while he corrected the mistake. signals.title: CARB filings reveal upcoming new Ducati model
signals.summary: Ducati looks set to launch a new model which will be the result of a collaboration with a luxury car maker. CARB (California Air Resources Board) filings in the US have shed light on a potential new Ducati model, which appears to be the result of a collaboration with luxury car maker Bentley. The filings specifically note two models, A ‘Ducati Diavel For Bentley’ and a ‘Ducati Diavel For Bentley Mulliner’. Both new machines appear in the same filing as the standard Diavel and a Diavel S. Mulliner is Bentley’s in-house bespoke division, responsible for the company’s most heavily personalised and exclusive cars. It has been around in various forms for more than 100 years, and today sits at the top of Bentley’s range and is responsible for creating one-off and limited-run models with higher levels of customisation and detailing than the standard cars. More details about the bikes, and what sets them apart from the standard models, aren’t known, as CARB filings only detail the machine’s environmental compliance, emissions, and climate risks. Should the new bikes be announced later this year, they would not be the first bikes to come via a collaboration with a car maker. In 2013, Ducati teamed up with the high-performance subsidiary of Mercedes, with the resulting run of Diavel Carbon AMG models totalling 743 limited edition units. signals.title: Custom-built Harley-Davidson Breakout wins new European competition
signals.summary: Harley-Davidson has confirmed the first winner of its recently-launched Creators Custom Clash competition, following a summer-long battle between six creators. Harley-Davidson has announced Jack NBC as the first winner of its new Creators Custom Clash competition. The Italian creator saw his Harley-Davidson Breakout machine presented as the winner of the competition at this summer’s European Bike Week 2026 event, which took place in Faak am See, Austria. The competition involved six creators from different European countries, all of which partnered with authorised Harley dealers to transform a stock motorcycle into a one-of-a-kind custom build. Although it was Jack NBC’s Breakout machine that won the competition, all six builds were displayed together for the first time at European Bike Week 2026. The winning build took on a performance-inspired approach that included aggressive styling cues, and heavy use of premium components. While experienced with customising Harley-Davidson motorcycles, the Creators Custom Clash build was Jack NBC’s most ambitious yet, according to Harley-Davidson. French creator, Eskyas, produced a striking Street Bob build, while Spain's Javier Gallardo transformed a stock Low Rider into a machine called, “Nómada”, which is a modern chopper inspired by freedom, exploration and life on the road. In the UK, tattoo artist Miles Langford revealed a Clubsport-inspired Street Bob, blending high-performance engineering with personalised artistic touches. Fran

signals.title: MV Agusta speaks out about “operational and financial difficulties”
signals.summary: MV Agusta has confirmed it is working through a period of financial imbalance, while saying reports surrounding its future contain speculation and incomplete information. MV Agusta has responded to reports that it has halted motorcycle production at its Varese factory, with the Italian manufacturer confirming that it is working through a period of financial and operational difficulty. The statement comes after reports emerged earlier this week claiming that production had been paused following the collapse of a proposed agreement with CFMoto. That agreement was reportedly set to see CFMoto take a 49 per cent stake in MV Agusta and provide investment as part of a wider restructuring plan. MV Agusta has not directly confirmed the reported production halt or the details of the CFMoto agreement. It has, however, confirmed that the company has been working for several months to restore its financial position following its separation from KTM and that it has entered Italy's Composizione Negoziata della Crisi (CNC) process. The CNC is a legal framework intended to help companies experiencing temporary financial imbalance work with creditors and other stakeholders while developing a route towards recovery. In UK business terms, it’s not a million miles from the formal restructuring process businesses on this side of the channel use. signals.title: Royal Enfield updates 350 range and launches new finance offers
signals.summary: More choice, more kit and new ways to ride: Royal Enfield updates its 350cc range and finance offers Buying a new bike doesn’t mean compromising on style, substance, or value anymore, thanks to Royal Enfield, which has updated its hugely popular 350cc range. Boosting the family for 2026 is more tech and convenience, while a series of current finance and accessory offers gives riders more ways to buy a new machine and then make it their own. The HNTR 350 and Meteor 350 both now benefit from an assist and slipper clutch, making gear changes easier while helping to maintain control while downshifting. Both also feature Royal Enfield’s Tripper navigation pod, alongside fast-charging USB-C connectivity on the handlebars and LED lighting. The HNTR 350 remains one of the most accessible ways into Royal Enfield ownership, with monthly payments starting from £59.99 a month and prices starting at £3,899 for the Rio White version. The classy-looking London Red and Tokyo Black models are priced at a slightly higher but still affordable £3,999. The Meteor 350 offers a little more laid-back touring ability, also with monthly payments from £59.99 and prices ranging from £4,099 for Fireball Orange through to £4,299 for Sundowner Orange. There is also a choice of Stellar Matt Grey at £4,199, plus Supernova Black and Aurora Retro Green at £4,249. signals.title: We might not be able to ride the Nürburgring like we used to, but you can now buy a special edition BMW that honours it
signals.summary: BMW Motorrad is celebrating the Nürburgring’s 100th anniversary with limited-edition M 1000 RR, R and XR models. BMW is marking the Nürburgring’s 100th anniversary with limited-edition versions of its M1000 RR, M1000 R and M1000 XR, with just 23 examples of the three bikes coming to the UK. The ‘100 Jahre Nürburgring’ editions have been created to celebrate the German circuit’s centenary in 2027. The Nürburgring officially opened on June 18, 1927, and BMW Motorrad is producing 100 examples of each motorcycle worldwide. All three bikes get the same core anniversary treatment, including a historical Nürburgring Green paint finish, anniversary decals, carbon wheels, black sub-frames and swingarms, and an Alcantara-look seat with ‘100’ embroidery. There’s also a painted fuel tank featuring Nordschleife decoration, while the airbox cover carries a special anniversary design and ‘one of 100’ marking. The standard specification includes BMW’s M Track Package, while an M Cover Kit is supplied with the M1000 RR and M1000 R. BMW is also throwing in an M motorcycle mat carrying the 100 Jahre (years) Nürburgring logo and a rear paddock stand. The three bikes retain their distinct characters beneath the special paint and equipment. The BMW M1000 RR is the most track-focused of the trio, using BMW’s M-developed superbike package with its focus on aerodynamics, lightweight construction and outright circuit performance. signals.title: Pocher and Carl Fogarty unveil 1:4-scale Panigale V2 model
signals.summary: Pocher has teamed up with Carl Fogarty to reveal a 1:4-scale Ducati Panigale V2 Superquadro Final Edition, complete with more than 700 parts and working features. Ever wanted to own a Ducati that you can plonk on a coffee table? Well, now you can, as Pocher has revealed its stunning quarter scale Panigale V2 Superquadro Final Edition kit. Helping to reveal the new model was none other than Carl Fogarty, which took place at a special event at the Bike Shed, London. ‘Foggy’ is a four-time World Superbike Champion, each of which came courtesy of Ducati machinery. While Foggy also rode for Honda during his career, in both WSBK and MotoGP, his name is synonymous with the Borgo Panigale brand, meaning he holds legend status to Ducatisti worldwide. Finished in Ducati’s signature red, the 1:4-scale model recreates the Panigale V2 Superquadro Final Edition with more than 700 precision-engineered parts. That includes a detailed recreation of the engine and chassis, along with multi-textured fairings, a digital dash and working suspension. There are also a few moving parts, including steerable handlebars, working suspension and a functional chain, giving the model more in common with the real thing than your average static display piece. Pocher says the model takes more than 30 hours to build and carries a Skill Level 6 rating, so this isn’t quite a case of snapping a few bits together and sticking it on the shelf. signals.summary: Land Cruiser FJ Meluncur Akhir 2026, Harga di Bawah Rp 1 Miliar? JAKARTA, KOMPAS.com PT Toyota Astra Motor (TAM) menargetkan Toyota Land Cruiser FJ meluncur di Indonesia pada akhir 2026. SUV yang membawa DNA keluarga Land Cruiser tersebut saat ini masih dalam tahap studi dan finalisasi sebelum resmi dipasarkan. Marketing Director PT Toyota Astra Motor (TAM) Bansar Maduma mengatakan, Toyota masih menentukan waktu yang tepat untuk memperkenalkan Land Cruiser FJ kepada konsumen. Meski demikian, perusahaan menargetkan peluncuran dapat dilakukan sebelum tutup tahun. Yang jelas, targetnya akhir tahun. Jadi diharapkan akhir tahun kami bisa meluncurkan, sehingga teman-teman ataupun customer yang sudah menunggu bisa merasakan dan memiliki produk ini, kata Bansar di Yogyakarta (14/9/2026). signals.summary: Valentino Rossi Sambut Nicolo Bulega Gabung VR46 di MotoGP 2027 JAKARTA, KOMPAS.com Valentino Rossi menyambut positif keputusan Nicolo Bulega bergabung dengan tim VR46 Ducati untuk menjalani debut penuh di MotoGP 2027. Bulega akan naik kelas ke MotoGP setelah tampil dominan di Kejuaraan Dunia Superbike (WorldSBK) musim ini. Pebalap Ducati tersebut telah menyepakati kontrak dengan tim milik Rossi untuk musim depan. Kepindahan Bulega ke VR46 juga menjadi cerita menarik. Pasalnya, pebalap asal Italia itu pernah menjadi bagian dari tim VR46 saat mengawali kariernya di ajang Grand Prix. Namun, perjalanan Bulega di ajang Grand Prix tidak berjalan mulus. Selama tampil di Moto3, dia hanya mengoleksi dua podium. Sementara itu, tiga musim di Moto2 juga tidak menghasilkan podium untuk Bulega. Setelah itu, Bulega berpisah dengan VR46 Academy dan melanjutkan kariernya di World Supersport pada 2022. Bulega berhasil menjadi juara dunia World Supersport pada 2023 sebelum melanjutkan kiprahnya di WorldSBK bersama Ducati. Dalam dua musim pertamanya di WorldSBK, Bulega finis sebagai runner-up. Sementara musim ini, dia tampil dominan dan berada di jalur untuk merebut gelar juara dunia. Kami sangat senang dan sangat bangga, ujar Rossi, mengutip Crash , Selasa (15/9/2026).
